title: WebDesk Growth Dashboard — Audit Event
description: Formalizes the audit_events shape from knowledge/10-data-ownership-and-audit.md. Immutable once written (WDS-012) except via the retention-deletion job. Distinct from, and more retention-lifecycle-aware than, the base skill's project.json audit_log — see docs/implementation/gap-analysis.md item 10.

entity_type.description: The record type this event concerns, e.g. 'page', 'case_study', 'release', 'user', 'role'.

entity_version.description: The exact version this event concerns — never 'the current version'. Null where not applicable (e.g. a login event).

before_state.description: Redacted per confidentiality rules (knowledge/12-dashboard-security-controls.md) before storage — never a raw dump of a confidential field.

reason.description: Required (application-level, not schema-level) for rejections, revisions, overrides, and security exceptions.

git_commit_sha.description: Where applicable, per knowledge/06-github-app-integration.md's SHA-verification rule.

legal_hold.description: When true, this event is excluded from the retention-deletion job regardless of age. Overrides retention_category unconditionally.

created_at.description: Immutable once written. No application code path updates this row except the retention-deletion job's delete (never update).
